initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished, high-fidelity comparison image of TWO proposed native macOS Glance popover panels side by side: Claude subscription details on the left, Codex subscription details on the right. This is an image of a future UI, with illustrative sample data. Large landscape canvas approximately 1800 by 1400, crisp very readable text. Two panels about 650 pixels wide, 1120 pixels tall. Clean off-white Mac utility UI, SF Pro-style typography, graphite text, fine light-gray separators, modest rounded corners and subtle shadows. Uniform pale cool-gray background. No vignette, no glows. Claude has muted terracotta accents; Codex has native blue accents. Visually match the restraint of an elegant Activity Monitor-like utility. Detailed and compact; no giant percentage hero, no huge padding, no marketing panels.

Canvas title at top: "More than a remaining percentage"
Subtitle: "Glance · Proposed subscription details · Illustrative data"

Above each panel a short compact menu-bar strip showing CPU 24%, Memory 61%, Claude 58%, Codex 35%. Highlight Claude in the left strip and Codex in the right. Small pointer connects each selected item to the correct popover. Each is a separate example state.

LEFT PANEL, exact hierarchy:
Header: back chevron "Overview", small Claude starburst icon, bold "Claude", refresh icon.
Small line "Max plan" with right-aligned "Updated just now".
A small tab bar "Summary" selected, "Activity", "History".
Section "Subscription allowance"
Two compact rows with slender colored bars:
"5-hour" on left, "76% left" right; under bar "Resets in 2h 18m".
"Weekly" on left, "58% left" right; under bar "Resets Thu, 16:12".
Small disclosure row "Model & feature limits" with "2 available" and right chevron.
Thin separator.
Section "Weekly allowance consumed"
Two side-by-side small stat tiles, NOT gigantic:
"Today" / "12 points"
"Yesterday" / "11 points"
Small caption "Observed percentage-point increase".
Small bar chart titled "This quota period". Six thin terracotta bars labeled "Thu" "Fri" "Sat" "Sun" "Mon" "Today". Values 0, 6, 4, 9, 11, 12; actual heights must reflect those values; Today highlighted. No future bars, no pace lines.
One slim row below: "Last completed week" on left, "78% used · 22% unused" right.
Thin separator.
Section "Local model activity" with small badge "Today".
Small caption "Claude Code · On this Mac".
Two horizontal rows, each model name, colored proportional short bar, and token total:
"Sonnet" "1.0M tokens"
"Opus" "800k tokens"
Small note "Token activity is separate from subscription quota."
Footer left "History starts when tracking is enabled" in small gray, right small icon for info. Final bottom action row "All activity" and "Open usage page ↗".

RIGHT PANEL, exact hierarchy:
Header: back chevron "Overview", small Codex icon, bold "Codex", refresh icon.
Small line "Pro plan" with right-aligned "Updated just now".
Same tab bar "Summary" selected, "Activity", "History".
Section "Subscription allowance"
"5-hour" left, "81% left" right; slender blue bar; beneath "Resets in 3h 05m".
"Weekly" left, "35% left" right; slender blue bar; beneath "Resets Thu, 16:12".
Disclosure row "Model & feature limits" with "View all" and chevron.
Thin separator.
Section "Weekly allowance consumed"
Two stat tiles:
"Today" / "18 points"
"Yesterday" / "17 points"
Small caption "Observed percentage-point increase".
Small bar chart "This quota period". Six blue bars labeled "Thu" "Fri" "Sat" "Sun" "Mon" "Today". Values 5, 8, 7, 10, 17, 18, actual heights proportional. Today highlighted.
One slim row "Last completed week" on left, "91% used · 9% unused" right.
Thin separator.
Section "Usage by tool" with small badge "Today".
Small caption "Connected web dashboard · reported credits".
Four compact horizontal rows with short proportional blue bars and the values:
"Desktop" / "180"
"CLI" / "90"
"VS Code" / "45"
"GitHub reviews" / "15"
Small note "Usage units, not a percentage of your weekly limit."
Slim subtle row "Usage resets" / "1 available · expires Sep 30".
Final bottom action row "All activity" and "Open usage page ↗".

Critical constraints: Do not display any dollars, prices, cost estimate, API billing, spend, price comparisons, or fake number of messages left. Keep the dashboard-reported credits separate from quota percentages and local token counts. Do not invent Claude per-tool quota allocation or per-task subscription percentages. All amounts are illustrative and main subtitle must say so. Keep type sizes readable, rows precise, no clipped bottom content. Short tab bars and headers, rich useful data, calm native utility appearance. Both panels aligned at top with same footer baseline; slightly adjust vertical spacing to fit. No real user's name or email.
finalEditPrompt: Edit ONLY the colored fill lengths of the first two blue horizontal subscription allowance bars in the RIGHT Codex panel. The first bar labeled '5-hour' and '81% left' must have its blue fill extend to exactly 81 percent of the light gray track. The second bar labeled 'Weekly' and '35% left' must have blue fill extend to exactly 35 percent of the light gray track. Currently their lengths do not match their text. Preserve ALL text, all other bars/charts, entire layout, colors, fonts, title, left Claude panel and other pixels exactly. Two blue fill lengths only. No text changes.
note: Proposed UI with illustrative data, not implemented. History depends on retained readings; web breakdown requires a separate connection; local activity is distinct from quota consumption.
